raw.details:
Overview

SETU is a beginner-friendly hybrid technology innovation challenge by Forge Realm, where students turn problems into practical solutions.

Participants can compete individually or in teams of 1–4 and build solutions around Problem Statements that will be revealed on the event day.

How will SETU be organised?

  • Hybrid — Offline and Online Tracks
  • 3 Problem Statements — Revealed on the event day
  • Build a practical solution or prototype
  • Beginner-friendly — No previous hackathon experience required

Join Your SETU Track Group

After registering for SETU, join the community group for your chosen participation track.

Offline Track

Join the Offline Track Group: Group Link

Online Track

Join the Online Track Group: Group Link

Important: Please join the group corresponding to the track you selected during registration. All important announcements, updates, participant instructions and event communication will be shared through the respective community group.

Who Can Participate?

SETU is open to students across branches, years and experience levels. You can participate solo or form a team of up to 4 members.

You don't need to be an expert. SETU is about understanding a problem, thinking of a solution, building it and showing why it matters.

Event

  • Date: 17 October 2026
  • Mode: Online participation

The Problem Statements, detailed submission requirements and judging criteria will be announced as part of the event.
